default_timeout_ms.title: Default timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: Timeout used when a process tool call does not specify one.

max_background_processes.title: Background process limit
max_background_processes.description: Maximum background process handles retained by this Plugin instance. Completed processes still count until their handles are released.

max_background_log_bytes.title: Log size limit (bytes)
max_background_log_bytes.description: Combined stdout and stderr retained per background process. Further output is truncated when this limit is reached.
